counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext extraction with heading-bounded functional segments. Line-wrap hyphenation is repaired; running headers, page numbers, displayed equations, table bodies, captions, and bullet markers are excluded where identifiable. Counts are mechanical drafts until reconciled against the 11-page contact sheet.
ambiguities: PDF page 1 is the unnumbered Summary; printed body page numbers begin on PDF page 2.
Several headings share a page, so heading markers rather than whole-page allocation define chapter boundaries.
Equations and matrix rows on PDF pages 5-8 fragment extracted prose and require visual paragraph reconciliation.
The final recommendation bullets continue from PDF page 10 to page 11 before the references heading.
